title: Google’s $899 Googlebook: Is Gemini-First Hardware Worth the Premium Price?
description:
Google’s $899 Googlebook: Is Gemini-First Hardware Worth the Premium Price?. Google just opened preorders for an $899 AI-centric laptop, while Amazon is actively blocking Meta’s shopping assistant. We’ll break down what these moves mean for your wallet and your digital autonomy.

What we covered:
• Google opens $899 Googlebook preorders with Gemini-centered features
• Meta's AI assistant Muse gets blocked from shopping on Amazon
• Bill Gates urges 'smart use' of AI as the Gates Foundation builds more representative language data
• Alibaba unveils new AI chip and next-generation model plan ahead of Trump-Xi meeting
• US proposes AI incident alert mechanism in China talks

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you pay a $300 premium for a laptop if it guaranteed an AI assistant that could handle your shopping and scheduling?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
